newsitem.title: MOROCCO: MOROCCO BUYS 3,500 T BARLEY INSTEAD OF 30,000 T.
newsitem.headline: MOROCCO BUYS 3,500 T BARLEY INSTEAD OF 30,000 T.

text.p: Morocco purchased 3,500 tonnes of barley this week instead of 30,000 tonnes planned earlier, an official at the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses (ONICL) said on Thursday.
"We purchased only one lot of 3,500 tonnes of barley which was available on the domestic market instead of the 30,000 tonnes scheduled," the official said.
He said the lot was imported earlier but gave no details of the purchase price.

According to a local trader, "Morocco's move was influenced by the mixture of a soaring U.S. dollar and high cereal prices on the international market...Morocco is looking for a better opportunity before launching a huge tender."
